description: Per-layer normalized reconstruction. Live run 7812 (global NMSE) fits layer 2 (59% of ||y||^2, of which 99.5% is dim #447) to rel_fro 0.062 while layers 5-8 sit at rel_fro 0.86-0.91 with <2 active features/token. Prediction: per-layer normalization raises mid-layer L0 and drops mid-layer rel_fro, at the cost of a worse AGGREGATE rel_fro (which was mostly a dim-447 score). Identical to 7812 except recon_normalization.
